recipe.title: Pumpkin Chili Turkey Skillet
recipe.summary: A cozy one-skillet turkey chili with pumpkin puree, warm chili seasoning, and a cooling Greek yogurt topping.
recipe.story: Canned pumpkin adds body and a subtle sweetness that balances the chili spice, while a scoop of Greek yogurt stands in for sour cream on top.
ingredients: 1 cup Simple Truth chicken bone broth
1 (15 oz) can pinto beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 cup non-fat plain Chobani Greek yogurt, for topping
instructions: Brown the ground turkey in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up as it cooks, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the pumpkin puree, bone broth, and Kinder's Woodfired chili seasoning until combined.
Add the pinto beans and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened.
Ladle into bowls and top each serving with a dollop of Chobani Greek yogurt in place of sour cream.
Finish with chopped cilantro if desired.
tips: The Greek yogurt swap keeps the topping just as creamy and cool, with more protein and less fat than sour cream.
Canned pumpkin adds body without tasting like pumpkin pie — the chili seasoning stays front and center.
This chili freezes well for up to 3 months; thaw overnight in the fridge before reheating.
